system.description:
A smartlink system connects the weapon to the user’s mesh inserts, placing a targeting bracket in the character’s field of vision and providing range and targeting information. Apply a +10 modifier to the Attack Test. Smartlinks also incorporate a microcamera that allows the user to see what the weapon is pointed at, fire around corners, etc. Smartlinks also allow certain other types of weapon system control, such as changing flux ammo (p. 337) or programming seeker trigger conditions (p. 199).

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 342.
